The '''Mid-Season Invitational''' (MSI) features the winners from 12 individual Riot leagues spring splits competing in the 6th annual tournament. In this year, it is headed to Reykjavík - the capital of Iceland.<ref name="announcement">{{cite web|url=https://lolesports.com/article/msi-2021-is-heading-to-reykjavik,-iceland/blt5ce2353d09227156|title=MSI 2021 is Heading to Reykjavik, Iceland|author=LoLEsports Staff|publisher=Riot Games|date=2021-03-01|language={{Flag|usuk}}English}}</ref> The games will be played at the Laugardalshöll indoor sporting arena, where the historic “Match of the Century” 1972 World Chess Championship was held.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''May 6th - 11th, 2021''
** Eleven teams are split into one group of three and two groups of four teams
** Group A will play in a Quadruple Round-Robin format
** Group B & C will play in a Double Round-Robin format
** <span class="bg-up">Top two teams</span> per group advance to the next stage
** <span class="bg-down">Bottom two teams</span> are eliminated
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
** The groups draw was announced on March 31st, 2021<ref name="MSI Draw and Prizes">{{cite web|url=https://lolesports.com/article/msi-2021-group-draw-and-prize-updates/bltf3aff06c2db95be5|title=MSI 2021: Group Draw and Prize Updates|date=2021-03-30|author=Lol Esports Staff|publisher=Riot Games|language={{Flag|usuk}} English}}</ref>
{{note||'''Note:''' Due to national travel restrictions related to COVID-19, the qualifying team from '''Vietnam''' [[File:GIGABYTE Marines allmode.png|GAM Esports|36px]] [[GAM Esports]] will unfortunately not be able to participate.<ref name="Teams Update">{{cite web|url=https://lolesports.com/article/msi-2021-teams-update/blt328f8f08bea703f8|title=MSI 2021: Teams Update|date=2021-04-20|author=Tom Martell, Director of Operations|publisher=Riot Games|language={{Flag|usuk}}English}}</ref> Despite having to continue with one less team, the format of the tournament will not change. VCS was slated to start in Group A along with the teams from the LPL (China), LCL (CIS), and LCO (Oceania). This group begins the tournament with the remaining 3 teams and the top 2 will advance to the next stage of the competition as originally planned. Groups B and C will remain unaffected.}}

* '''Rumble Stage''' - ''May 14th - 18th, 2021''
** Six remaining teams play in another Double Round-Robin format 
** <span class="bg-up">Top four teams</span> advance to Knockout Stage
** <span class="bg-down">Bottom two teams</span> are eliminated
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}

* '''Knockout Stage''' - ''May 21st - 23rd, 2021''
** The first place team of Rumble Stage will choose to face either the third or fourth place team
** Single-Elimination bracket
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}

* '''Patch Information'''
** {{ChampionIcon|Viego|20px}} [[Viego]] and {{ChampionIcon|Gwen|20px}} [[Gwen]] are disabled for this tournament due to the ''"New Champions and VGUs must be enabled for playoffs in all four of the top regions in order to be playable at the next international tournament."'' policy.<ref name="viego banned">{{cite web|url=https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/dev/dev-balancing-for-pro-play/|title=/dev: Balancing for Pro Play|author=Summoner's Rift Team|publisher=Riot Games|date=2020-08-19|language={{Flag|usuk}}English}}</ref>
